T0531.title: CI/CD
T0531.definition: Continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines used to build, test, package, and release software.
T0531.description: CI/CD pipelines connect source code, dependencies, secrets, build artifacts, and production release privileges, making them important software-supply-chain entry points. Risks include abused runners, leaked variables, tampered build scripts, and unauthorized releases. Controls focus on least privilege, branch protection, environment isolation, auditability, and build provenance.
T0531.usageExample: Assess CI/CD related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
